html_source: Something striking about this chapter in the book is how current Molly’s dialogue feels to a modern reader. I think the issue Molly is having with Leopold seeing other women feels so modern. The long hair on his coat reminds me of the scene from Clueless when Dion holds the hair extension up to her boyfriend asking him whose it is. I was definitely entertained when reading this chapter.
